packs.label: Dynasty capitals
packs.description: Historical names with dynasty context. Successive names at the same city share one dot; modern locations appear in answers and Preview.

packs.label: Ancient battlefields
packs.description: Representative locations of major battles. Dots identify the locality or traditional site, not the full battlefield extent.

packs.label: Silk Road stops
packs.description: Oasis towns, gateways and archaeological sites from China into Central Asia.

packs.label: Sacred mountains
packs.description: The Five Great Mountains, four Buddhist mountains and four celebrated Taoist mountains. Dots are geographic references, not boundaries.

packs.label: Great Wall passes
packs.description: Historic passes, gates and defensive junctions along the Great Wall.

packs.label: Imperial tombs
packs.description: Imperial mausoleums and grouped burial complexes from Qin through Qing. Groups use one reference dot.

packs.label: Grottoes & ancient temples
packs.description: Cave-art complexes and major historic Buddhist temples across China.

packs.label: Poets’ birthplaces
packs.description: Locate poets by their birthplaces, using locality dots rather than exact birth houses. Li Bai uses the Suyab attribution in present-day Kyrgyzstan; disputed traditions are noted.
